tiers.text: The pins on the yard door are on the outside, where a child could reach them. Under the back room, the vein runs warm and shallow.

variants.text: The pavement flap over the cellar is rotten at the hinge. Somebody has weighted it with a crate rather than mend it.

tiers.text: The door to the back yard is old, painted shut in some places and not in others.

physics.miss: Shop glass, steel shutters, a door that's bolted. Nothing here gives.

tiers.text: One on the till, tired, with a queue she's stopped seeing. Two in the back, stocking nothing. And a regular at the counter who has been there longer than the stock has.
Someone is in the back besides whoever's on the till. They're moving boxes from one pile to the same pile.

life.miss: Everyone has a basket or an apron. You can't tell which is which.

tiers.text: The till worker would look the other way for a good enough story. The man in the back would rather be anywhere else.
The woman on the till hates this job, and has been hating it quietly for years.

emotion.miss: Tired faces, bored faces. Nothing you can use.

tiers.text: The delivery comes at a set minute, and the drayman opens the pavement flap for it every time, and shuts it after.

variants.text: The camera over the till loops every ninety seconds. The man on the screen picks his nose in the fifth.

tiers.text: Deliveries come round the back. A van does it twice a night, almost on time.

time.miss: Vans come and go. You couldn't say which hour, or who was in them.

tiers.text: A ward sits on the cellar stairs, faint as a draught under a door.

variants.text: The till camera has a red light and nothing behind it. It hasn't recorded a thing in a while.

tiers.text: The CCTV is wrong. The monitor shows the till, but the till isn't quite where it ought to be.

fate.miss: No chances you can see here. It's a shop, and it's open.

cards.label: {today} — The approach
cards.text: The shop is lit and doing a little trade. A man with a basket goes in, a woman comes out with a bottle. Under the back room, the vein goes on without them. You case it twice.
A lit shopfront, a till, a yard door round the back. The front is public. Anyone can walk in.

choices.label: Walk in as a customer
choices.result_text: You push the door and a bell goes. No one looks up.

choices.label: Round the back
choices.result_text: You go round by the side passage, past the bins and the smell of old cooking oil.

cards.text: What you saw buys other ways in.

choices.label: The cellar flap
choices.result_text: You crouch at the pavement flap. The street goes by on one side of you and the cellar breathes on the other.

success.result_text: The fold opens inside the cellar. The air is cold and smells of damp cardboard.

fail.result_text: The fold lands you in the cellar, and not unseen. Someone down here has put down a crate.

cards.text: You go in with the others, behind a man buying a lottery ticket.
The till, the queue, and the door marked STAFF ONLY. She's looking at the card machine, not at you.

success.result_text: "Is there a toilet?" She waves at the staff door with her whole arm. You go through it and she doesn't look up again.

fail.result_text: "Customers only. Staff toilet's not for customers." She puts a hand flat on the counter. Her face says she's had this conversation before.

choices.label: Spin her the story she wants

success.result_text: You tell her the story she needs. Her eyebrow goes up, then down. She nods at the door as if that's all it was.

fail.result_text: She hears you out, then asks who exactly you came to see. You don't have the answer, and her hand goes under the counter.

choices.label: Wait until she's serving the regular

success.result_text: The regular starts talking and the till worker starts nodding. You walk through the back door while she's still nodding.

fail.result_text: The regular finishes his story just as you reach the door. "Where are you off to?"

cards.text: Or leave it to chance.

choices.label: Hope the card machine goes down

success.result_text: The card machine dies mid-payment. She hits it twice and swears at it, and you pass behind her.

fail.result_text: The card machine works fine. She looks up from it, straight at you.

choices.label: Prophet's Breath: know when she's busy
choices.result_text: You know when she'll turn to the till, and you move on that.

cards.text: The yard door, old and painted shut-ish.

fail.result_text: The pins are painted in. One snaps off and the sound goes into the yard.

choices.label: Blast the door
